google-drive.description: Google Drive + Docs + Sheets + Slides + Calendar, via @piotr-agier/google-drive-mcp (npx-launched Node MCP server, stdio transport). Same y/n-per-call confirmation model as read_file/run_shell in llmcli.py --tools - broad capability, not blind autonomy.
notes: System Node (/usr/bin/node) on this machine is v12 (EOL, apt) and cannot run this server - it uses ES2022 top-level await and dies with 'SyntaxError: Unexpected reserved word'. A modern Node 22 LTS is already downloaded standalone (no sudo) to /home/mateo/local-llm/.tools/node22/. Whatever launches this 'npx' command (this client, or the user running the auth command by hand) needs that node22/bin ahead of system node on PATH. See cli/mcp_smoke_test.py for the exact, already-proven-working invocation pattern (it hardcodes the node22 paths and explains why 'env node' re-resolution defeats a naive fix) - reuse that pattern here rather than re-deriving it.

The token cache (tokens.json) is left at the server's own default (~/.config/google-drive-mcp/tokens.json), outside this repo - only the OAuth client credentials file lives at credentialsPath above, and only that path needs to be gitignored.
